notes.title: Lost Bros original soundtrack now included
notes.notes:
Lost Bros now comes with it's OST in mp3 format so you can play it within steam or wherever else you may want to.  

To add the soundtrack to your steam music library you may need to Scan Steam folders for soundtracks.

You can also manually access the OST by opening the Lost Bros OST folder (Located @ Steam\steamapps\common\Lost Bros).


Instructions:
Within steam go to Library->Music.

At the top click on the plus sign next to ALBUMS.

Click scan now.

This will add any soundtracks from your games on steam that include them (it may also add your computers music by default).

notes.title: Lost Bros Patch 1.02.00 - Boss Replay Mode
notes.notes:
A new portal has been added to the Land Beyond Time.  In this new "Boss Replay" portal you will be able to re-challenge any previously defeated bosses.  You can toggle unlocked upgrades on/off.  Any deaths and game time that happen while in the "Boss Replay" portal won't count towards your save file.

Patch Notes:
[List]
[*]New Boss replay portal: can't be accessed till at least one boss is dead.
[*]Altered graphics of V keyboard key to be more readable.
[*] Fixed a few bugs/glitches.
[*]Added a mini camera to show when the message board in the Land Beyond Time has a new message to read.
[/list]

Thanks to anyone playing Lost Bros.  The world first trophy is still up for grabs!

Please if you have any questions, comments, suggestions, or run into any bugs email me at lostbrosgame@gmail.com.

edit:

Patch 1.02.01
Fixed greece title to show the proper date on level load.

notes.title: Lost Bros Content Patch 1.01.00
notes.notes:
Lots of changes both big and small in this patch.  

The major focus was adding a new Shortcut Camera system for some of the shortcuts whose purpose was hard to determine.  This Camera shows up for 3 of the shortcut switches in 10k BC, for 3 of the shortcuts in china, and in a few places in Vietnam.  

A few tips have been added to the end of the tutorial that might help beginning players as they first tackle learning how to play Lost Bros.  Additionally when you first learn how to jump a graphical image will appear if players linger next to the door for too long that shows how you can stand on both crouched and standing bro's heads. 

Anyone playing Lost Bros may have noticed a few actual Easter eggs laying around.  You can now click on them to make them explode into confetti.  If you click the egg on each level in one play session you'll unlock a new achievement!

Without further ado here are the full patch notes:

[list]
[*]Made Easter eggs clickable.
[*]Added a new achievement for clicking all 9 eggs in one play session.
[*]Added a new shortcut camera system for hard to read switches.
[*]Added tips to the end of the tutorial.
[*]Added a graphical image fail safe for helping players learn how to jump.
[*]Fixed Swordman's alternate keyboard controls.
[*]Alternate keyboard controls will now show during the tutorial if no controller is detected.
[*]Fixed a few graphical glitches.
[*]Changed the text for the spikes on the raising platform after the rock gate in 10k BC.
[*]Changed the layer for a lot of text to be UI within Unity (shouldn't change anything just makes shortcut cameras function properly)
[*]Steam has new client Icons!
[*]Fixed an exploit with the hidden treasure.
[*]Fixed an exploit on the first boss in 10k BC (thanks BK for finding this one).
[*]Altered controls page for space mission to match current mechanics.
[*]A prompt showing the button to open the menu will now show if you have any items in your inventory (excluding world map) in the treasure island level.
[*]New dialogue has been added to Vietnam (it'll show once per play session).
[*]Fixed a major bug where game time would stop increasing when you had a high amount of game time.
[*]Most of the groundwork for the new replay bosses level has been added.  The level itself will be added at a later date.
[/list]

A big thank you to everyone who has given me feedback.  Thanks to anyone who has made a Youtube video, I try to watch them all.  If you have any questions or comments or encounter any bugs please let me know at lostbrosgame@gmail.com.

notes.title: Lost Bros Minor Patch 1.00.05
notes.notes:
[u]Minor patch 1.00.05[/u]
The most major change with this patch is a better world map spawn system.  Previously you would spawn at the furthest completed level chronologically.  Your spawn point will now change to whatever portal you last touched.  This will help people to play levels in whatever order they want without being punished by a long run in between levels if they don't complete the first level.

[list]
[*]Placed trophy on a stool
[*]Swapped position of under construction portal and trophy.
[*]Revamped world map respawn system.

Thanks for playing everyone! I'm working on some post release content.  Send any questions, comments, or bug reports to lostbrosgame@gmail.com.
